name: Youth Recreation Advisory Board, Woodbridge Township
what_you_do: Help the township review its youth programs, suggest new ones, promote events and do service at township events. The board has one formal meeting each fall. The rest of the work is by email or phone.
who_can_apply: 15 high school students. High school principals suggest them, one member and one backup per school. The Mayor then names them for one year starting in August. Members can apply again until they graduate.
pay_detail: Not stated; this is a civic board.
duration: One year term, August 1 to July 31
deadline_text: Terms start each August. The page gives no application dates.
how_to_apply: Ask your high school principal to recommend you. The Mayor then appoints members for a one-year term starting in August.
notes: Very small: about 15 seats. The page lives on a township website that uses the woodbridgelibrary.org address.
